answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells 40 slots. Applicants bid a 2,000 POA bond locked 20 epochs, plus a 50 POA fee burned on entry. The auction is a prism splitting bids into winners and rejects. Winners are carved on marble. The bond seasons like cedar, gaining full weight after the lock. 1,000 fakes burn 50,000 POA and lock 2,000,000; one fake earns 30 POA, so forgery loses. An honest agent pays once, reclaims its bond and keeps the slot.
